sections.Profile:
The "Jolly Joker" pinball machine, produced by Italian manufacturer Mondialmatic in 1979, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game featuring a playing cards theme. Designed as a conversion kit for Gottlieb's 1973 'Ten-Up', it includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, five standup targets, two banks of four drop targets, and two star rollovers, notably omitting slingshots.

- Manufacturer: Mondialmatic
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme, 1970s
